movement.definition: trailing path length in normalized structural state space

trajectory_openness.definition: net displacement divided by path length

recurrence_persistence.definition: causal recurrence persistence conditioned on sufficient movement

transport_coherence.definition: exp(-RMS(z_t - A_(t-1) z_(t-1))/s_(t-1)); A is fitted only on prior transitions
transport_coherence.residual_scale: causal median prior transition magnitude with a fixed floor
transport_coherence.fallback: UNRESOLVED; local continuity is not substituted

variation_capacity.definition: normalized effective rank of realized active structural updates
variation_capacity.claim_boundary: realized variation proxy, not the complete counterfactual viability kernel

regime_persistence.definition: consecutive crystallizing duration divided by one tau, clipped to one

state_machine.exhaustiveness_rule: every window has exactly one primary state or an explicit non-primary classification status
state_machine.STAGNANT: geometry ready and movement below threshold
state_machine.VIABLE: active, coherent, and recurrence below threshold
state_machine.RECURRENT: active, coherent, recurrent, and not contracting
state_machine.CRYSTALLIZING: active, coherent, recurrent, contracting, and persistence below one tau
state_machine.CRYSTALLIZED: CRYSTALLIZING predicate sustained for at least one tau

claim_boundary: Coherence is out-of-sample transition predictability, not net displacement.
All operator fitting is causal and excludes the current transition.
The observer receives numeric token observations only and never external compliance.
Parameters are universal across the three evaluated models.
